content.text:
New message in #sales:

dave: 😂😂 that deck though

Want me to reply? Here are a few quick options—pick one or tweak:

- Playful: “Haha — which part got the biggest laugh? Happy to tighten it up.”
- Professional: “Glad it caught attention. Any slides you’d change or cut?”
- Self‑aware: “Fair! We can punch it up—any spots that felt off?”
- Nudge to specifics: “Curious—format, messaging, or visuals? Feedback helps before next send.”

Say the word and I’ll post it in #sales or DM Dave.
